name: Town of Danville – American Mahjong (Danville Parks & Recreation)
description: Town of Danville recreation program: Introduction to American Mahjong classes and American Mahjong Open Play (seniors 55+ for open play) taught by Jean Melgar at the Veterans Memorial Building. Open play requires a recently completed intro class or seasoned play; bring a 2026 National Mah Jongg League card or pay an optional $15 material fee.
address: Veterans Memorial Building, 115 E. Prospect Avenue, Danville, CA 94526
schedule: Intro class Mon Dec 7, 2026; Open Play Wednesdays Dec 2-16, 2026; start times not shown on the registration pages
evidence_quote: Learn the fundamentals of American Mahjong. This class will cover tile identification, game play, the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) card and etiquette through guided instruction and hands on practice.

name: City of San Jose PRNS – Mah Jong: American Style Open Play (Camden Community Center)
description: Volunteer-led open play for ages 50+ who already know the game (intermediate/advanced) at Camden Community Center. Sets and tiles provided; players bring their own National Mah Jongg League card.
address: Camden Community Center, 3369 Union Ave, San Jose, CA 95124
schedule: Wednesdays Jan 6 - Mar 10, 2027 (an earlier session runs Sep 16 - Dec 9, 2026); start time not shown
evidence_quote: National Mah Jongg League 2027 Standard Hands and Rules card

name: Pleasanton Senior Center – Mah Jong
description: City of Pleasanton senior center drop-in Mah Jong (Pleasanton is in the Tri-Valley next to Danville). Flyer lists a drop-in fee of $3.50 residents / $4.00 non-residents. A separate Learn to Play American Mah Jongg flyer exists but could not be read.
address: Pleasanton Senior Center, 5353 Sunol Blvd, Pleasanton, CA 94566
evidence_quote: Must be familiar with American style Mah Jong.
